description: Rotates a secret value's sdk-secrets envelope pointer in place (secret_ref swapped, value cleared, re-activated). Operates on the row POST /api/config creates in this same run, consumed via {{cache:config.create.response.data.key}} rather than a seeded key, so no SQL seed is required. It is ordered LAST - after revoke - because rotateConfigSecret re-activates whatever it touches: running it on a revoked row is the interesting case and it leaves the row active with a secret_ref, which the next run's upsert resets back to a plain value. Tenant JWT required + scope-ownership guard. Edge cases: scope + key + secret_ref required (400); unknown row 404.

testCases.name: Rotate a tenant secret config value

errorCases.message: scope, key and secret_ref are required
